line: Do you know who's already grading how you drive, every time you get in the car?
It can track your speed, your braking, your location — without you doing anything.
That data can get sold to companies that help set your insurance rate — sometimes without you knowing.
One setting in your car's own app can switch that off.
It won't undo what's already gone out. You can still see your own file — for free.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
